# Atlanta Hearing Doctor

> Leading audiology practice in Atlanta offering advanced hearing aids, comprehensive testing, and personalized fitting services from Dr. Maria Wynens.

Atlanta Hearing Doctor is a professional audiology practice specializing in hearing loss treatment and hearing aid solutions. With over 36 years of experience, Dr. Maria Wynens provides comprehensive hearing tests, personalized fittings, and repair services using cutting-edge technology from major manufacturers including Phonak, ReSound, Oticon, Signia, Starkey, and Widex.
